children: Imperial Storm Commandos, also known as Shadow Scouts because of their black armor, are elite Stormtrooper units trained as saboteurs and assassins. Their missions include causing uprisings on systems with governments hostile to the Empire and putting down uprisings on worlds already part of the Empire.
They are also expert pilots and frequently employ modified
during deep infiltration missions. The Speeder Bikes as well as the Storm Commandos' armor are coated with matte-black reflec that deflects both light and sensor energy.
Their equipment, combined with their superior training in infiltration techniques, make Storm Commandos virtually undetectable either to the naked eye or to electronic scans.
